newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: China's Zhenhai refinery plans turnaround Mar-May.
newsitem.headline: China's Zhenhai refinery plans turnaround Mar-May.

text.p: China's Zhenhai Refining & Chemical Co Ltd is planning a two-stage maintenance programme for its 135,000-barrels-per-day refinery during March-May, a source close to the company said on Tuesday.
"We have a plan to shutdown the refinery from March to May but this may be postponed depending on the market situation," the source said.
On paper, the company plans to shutdown in the first stage a 75,000-bpd crude distillation unit (CDU) and a 30,000-bpd fluid catalytic cracker for one month in March.
In the second-stage, Zhenhai plans to shutdown the number two 60,000-bpd CDU and a 20,000-bpd hydrocracker also for a month beginning in April.
The source said the company will go ahead with the plans if there were no major changes to market direction.
"Two years ago we had a plan to shutdown the refinery in May but finally we advanced it to April because of the market," the source said.
Last December, Zhenhai completed a 1.6 billion yuan upgrading programme that raised refining output from 5.5 million tonnes per year to 8.0 million tonnes.
Zhenhai said it plans to raise capacity to 12 million tonnes per annum by 2000. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3093)
